# Art Graphica

> Comprehensive online art education platform offering free tutorials, lessons, and classical art books across all major drawing and painting mediums.

Art Graphica provides structured learning paths for beginners through advanced artists, featuring both contemporary tutorials and digitized classical art instruction books. The site covers fundamental techniques in drawing, painting, anatomy, and composition with resources from renowned artists and instructors.

## Key Topics

- Drawing techniques
- Painting techniques
- Figure drawing
- Artistic anatomy
- Pencil drawing
- Watercolor painting
- Oil painting
- Acrylic painting
- Landscape painting
- Portrait drawing
- Perspective drawing
- Charcoal drawing
- Art fundamentals
- Beginner guides
- Classical art instruction

## Core Learning Paths

- [Learn How to Draw - Drawing Online](http://www.artgraphica.net/learn-to-draw.html): Main online drawing course covering basics & pencil techniques
- [Art Lessons - Teach Yourself How to Draw and Paint](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/free-art-tutorials.htm): Comprehensive art lessons hub covering all major painting & drawing media
- [Art Shop Online](http://www.artgraphica.net/art-shop/art-shop.htm): Online art shop offering tutorials, guides & fine art resources

## Painting Tutorials

- [Free Watercolor Art Lessons](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/watercolor-painting-tutorials.html): Watercolor painting tutorials covering techniques, florals & landscapes
- [Free Oil Painting Lessons](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/oil-painting-lessons.html): Oil painting lessons including landscape & alla prima techniques
- [Acrylic Painting Lessons Art for Beginners](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/acrylic-painting-tutorials.html): Acrylic painting lessons with step-by-step tutorials for beginners
- [Painting with Pastels - Art Lessons](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/pastel-art-lessons.html): Pastel painting lessons with portrait, wildlife & landscape techniques

## Drawing Techniques & Methods

- [Learn How to Draw, Drawing for Beginners](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/drawing-pencil-tutorial.html): Beginner pencil drawing tutorial with portrait & technique lessons
- [Pen and Ink Drawing Lessons](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/pen-and-ink-tutorial.html): Pen and ink drawing lessons covering hatching, stippling & architecture
- [Charcoal Drawing Lessons](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/charcoal-art-tutorial.html): Charcoal drawing lessons for beginners covering portraits & landscapes
- [Drawing and Sketching Art Guide](http://www.artgraphica.net/art-shop/drawing-and-sketching.htm): Drawing & sketching guide with video lessons on composition & perspective
- [Drawing for Beginners, Drawing Book](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/drawing-for-beginners/drawing-for-beginners.html): Beginner drawing book covering basics, charcoal & figure drawing

## Classical Art Reference Books

- [Constructive Anatomy by George Bridgman, Free Online Art Book](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/constructive-anatomy-george-bridgman/constructive-anatomy-george-bridgman-art-book.html): Classic Constructive Anatomy by Bridgman covering figure & muscle structure
- [Artistic Anatomy, Free Art Book](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/drawing-for-art-students/artistic-anatomy.html): Free artistic anatomy book covering skeleton & muscle structure
- [Artistic Anatomy of Trees by Rex Vicat Cole](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/anatomy-of-trees/drawing-trees-001.html): Classical art book on tree drawing anatomy & landscape techniques
- [Drawing for Art Students and Illustrators, Free Book](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/drawing-for-art-students/drawing-for-art-students.html): Free drawing book for art students covering fundamentals & illustration
- [Freehand Drawing Techniques, Free Art Book](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/freehand-drawing/freehand-drawing.html): Free freehand drawing book with instructional methods & techniques

## Specialized Art Fundamentals

- [Light and Shade in Art, Free Art Book](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/light-shade-charcoal-pencil-brush-drawing/light-shade-charcoal-pencil-brush-drawing.html): Free art book on light & shade techniques with charcoal & pencil
- [Drawing in Perspective, Artists Book](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/perspective-for-artists/perspective-for-artists.html): Artists guide to perspective drawing & architectural composition

## Resources & References

- [Art Books - Resources for Artists, Students and Teachers](http://www.artgraphica.net/free-art-lessons/free-art-books.html): Curated art books & resources covering fundamentals & art theory
